summary: Round 7 — PWA end-to-end verification. All checks PASS: 10/10 static-asset tests, 26/26 backend regression tests (from round 6), and full Playwright DOM/SW/offline flow against http://localhost:3000 mobile viewport. GET /manifest.json returns 200 application/json with name=Travel Space, short_name=Travel Space, start_url=/, display=standalone, theme_color=#6B8E7A, background_color=#F7F5F0; icons array contains 192x192 any, 512x512 any, and 512x512 maskable; shortcuts include 'New trip' -> /trip/new. /sw.js served 200 application/javascript and source contains isApiRequest guard on /api/. All five icon endpoints (/icon-192.png, /icon-512.png, /icon-maskable-512.png, /apple-touch-icon.png, /favicon.png) return 200 image/png with 89 50 4E 47 magic bytes. Playwright confirmed at runtime: <link rel=manifest href ends with /manifest.json>, <meta name=theme-color content=#6B8E7A>, <meta name=apple-mobile-web-app-capable content=yes>, <meta name=apple-mobile-web-app-title content=Travel Space>, <link rel=apple-touch-icon href ends with /apple-touch-icon.png>, viewport meta contains viewport-fit=cover. Service worker registered manually from page context, became active within ~1s with scope http://localhost:3000/; fetch('/manifest.json') post-registration still returns 200 with name=Travel Space (SW did not break precache lookup). Offline/guest flow: tapped Continue-without-signing-in, tapped create-trip FAB, filled 'PWA Offline Trip', saved, reloaded — user is NOT bounced to login (STILL_ON_LOGIN_AFTER_RELOAD=false), lands on trip detail with back-btn present, JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ts:localstore:v1')).trips has length 1 with name 'PWA Offline Trip' preserved through reload, Documents tab opens with 'Attach visas, boarding passes...' empty state (no-network read works). API pass-through: fetch to public ingress /api/health returns 200 {status:ok} while the SW is active, proving the isApiRequest short-circuit lets network handle /api requests. Backend regression: round6 suite (health, PNG validity, DELETE /auth/me cascade, flight PATCH, documents blob strip, invite lifecycle) still 26/26 PASS against the current backend.
action_items: None — PWA feature is production-ready. Note that /sw.js self-registration is intentionally skipped on localhost:3000/19006 to keep Metro HMR clean; on the deployed public ingress origin registration will run automatically on window.load (verified logic; not exercised in this preview since the app is served from Metro dev at :3000).

Minor: fetch('/api/health') at same origin (localhost:3000) returns Metro's index.html because Metro doesn't proxy /api. This is fine — the SW correctly bypasses those requests. On the deployed ingress origin (same for frontend + backend) same-origin /api works, verified via https://explore-itinerary-30.preview.emergentagent.com/api/health -> 200 {status:ok}.
critical_code_review_comments: setupPwa() correctly guards Platform.OS !== 'web' and skips SW registration on Metro dev origins so hot reload isn't poisoned by a cached SW.
sw.js `isApiRequest` covers both '/api/' and exact '/api' — no accidental cache of the API root.
sw.js fetch handler returns early on non-GET, cross-origin, and API requests before any respondWith, so POST/PATCH/DELETE for /api endpoints are never intercepted.
Navigation network-first with cached '/' fallback is correct for a SPA shell. Precache list matches the actual static files under /app/frontend/public.
upsertHead() removes any prior singleton meta/link with the same name/rel before inserting — safe if setupPwa() is somehow called twice (also guarded by `installed` boolean).
manifest.json shortcut icon points to /icon-192.png which exists — no dangling icon reference.

Background 401s from the sync queue while offline on localhost:3000 are pre-existing (Metro returns HTML for /api which the sync worker parses as 401) — not introduced by this PWA change and does not affect user-visible flows.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data created. The 'PWA Offline Trip' created during Playwright testing lives only in the browser session's localStorage (guest mode never persisted to Mongo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PWA is now shipped. On localhost:3000 the SW must be registered manually from page context (setupPwa deliberately skips dev ports 3000/19006) — see /app/backend/tests/pwa_static_test.py plus the Playwright runbook in iteration_6 for the exact snippet. Do NOT expect fetch('/api/...') at same origin on :3000 to succeed — Metro dev server serves index.html for /api paths. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (public ingress) for API assertions where same-origin matters. `document.querySelector('link[rel=manifest]')` etc. are injected at runtime by src/pwa.ts and are only present AFTER the JS bundle boots — wait for '[data-testid=guest-btn]' before asserting head tags. Backend seed data (user_demo_marketing + trip 9fbdeac7-a11c-4be2-a448-9c8560a1b6ad + Bearer demo_marketing_token_12345) is untouched.
